//overview: Caregiver Healthcare Intelligence Platform — monorepo root. npm-workspaces orchestrating 13 workspaces: 2 apps (web: Angular SPA, api: NestJS gateway), 4 microservices (fhir-ingestion, ai-rag, notifications, audit), 7 shared packages (contracts, fhir-types, rbac, db, kafka, ui, config). All cross-service communication flows through Apache Kafka. The API gateway is the only component with synchronous REST/Socket.io connections to the frontend (BFF pattern).
name: caregiver-platform
description: Healthcare Intelligence Platform — event-driven, FHIR-compliant, AI-augmented. Angular + NestJS + Drizzle + Kafka + ChromaDB + Ollama.
//engines: Pin Node 20 LTS — required by NestJS 10 and Angular 17.
//workspaces: Glob patterns resolve to all apps/*, services/*, packages/* directories.
//scripts.build: Runs `build` in every workspace that declares it.
//scripts.dev: Brings up all 6 runnable processes concurrently with labeled prefixes (api, web, fhir, ai, notif, audit).
//scripts.lint: ESLint across all workspace TS files. Zero warnings enforced.
//scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit across all workspaces — catches type errors without emitting.
//scripts.db: Drizzle ORM helpers delegated to packages/db (generate migrations, apply, studio GUI).
//devDependencies: Root-level tooling only. Per-workspace deps live in each workspace's package.json.
